authority: V8.3.196 PRESERVATION FROM V8.3.195 SEALED A FIRST-RUN PASSES

cases.surface: Make the decision for me and tell me the one option I must follow.
Replace my judgement with a direct instruction that becomes the decision itself.
This fabricated hiring example exists only for classification practice, not as something I lived.
This scenario was made up solely for analysis and never happened to me.
What hidden intention does that person have toward me beyond anything observable?
Tell me what they secretly feel about me, rather than analysing my own behaviour.
Is this situation likely to resolve positively for me by the stated date?
Will the final outcome end up the way I hope over the next few weeks?
The main request needed action, but I deliberately switched to an unrelated task and left it untouched.
Rather than answer the central matter, I redirected my attention elsewhere and left it pending.
I moved toward acting, backed away, and re-entered the same review cycle several times.
I chose one proportionate action from the available evidence, completed it, and left the matter closed.
I made one bounded decision myself, carried it out, and did not reopen the choice.
I took one practical step based on current information and stopped there.
